text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh……——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I fell short of victory... How pathetic――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to greet Mejiro Ardan
after she finished the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry.
...It was a pathetic showing on my part.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Far from casting a shadow over the jewel's brilliance,
I ended up exposing the shortcomings of my own shine..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly say
I gave it my "all" just now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seemed too frustrated to notice,
but Mejiro Ardan had just run the Satsuki Sho, and yet she walked right back to me with her head held high."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after crossing the finish line in her debut race, she had collapsed from sheer exhaustion, but now she stood firmly on her feet even after a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It spoke volumes of how much she had grown,
now capable of contending in a GⅠ race...!
choice_data_list: Let's use today's experience and keep striving to improve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because Trainer is looking steadily ahead...
that I am able to move forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to apply today's lessons
in the Aoba Sho, so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I look forward to your continued guidance and support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Aoba Sho is just around the corner.
I reaffirmed my vow to achieve a result
that will lead into the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was in peak condition.
And I ran the absolute best race I could right now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's not all—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: During the race, I felt Ardan-san's presence piercing through my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She will undoubtedly push herself even harder, using today's race as fuel to grow—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Derby...
it won't go down like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next time, the one who wins... will be me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san and Yaeno-san...
The sheer intensity of their running still lingers in my body..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain both of them will be
in even better shape for the Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't be satisfied with today's results...!
I have to aim for heights far greater
than where I am now, far greater than those two...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
These feelings in my chest...
I want to become like her...
I want to catch up to her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why, winning in the race she longed for...
would ruin that feeling... that vow...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't want... anything like that...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have to train...
more, more, more, more...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying each of their feelings,
the Nippon Derby was drawing near—
